items.title: Bernard Steinau Interview, 1978-08-02
items.q: The interviewer mentions Jimmy Johnson in the context of a book on Buddy Bowler, but the interviewee does not respond with any personal connection or memory of Jimmy Johnson.

ctx.x: You got the bass player over there? No, we got him about a couple of three months after that.
Yeah. And who was he? Jimmy Johnson. I see. You know, he's got a nice write-up in a new book on Buddy Bowler.
Well, he was a great man, a great bass player.
